title: 341_110448_Records_Relating_to_the_Collection_and_Dissemination_of_Intelligence_1948-1955-TS_CONT_No.2_2-5300-2-5399
doc_notes: This document is a collection of intelligence reports from the Directorate of Intelligence, Headquarters U.S. Air Force, containing one specific encounter report regarding a Swedish investigation into a crashed object.

encounters.summary: A Swedish technical expert observed a flying saucer crash or land in a lake; a subsequent naval salvage operation discovered an uncharted crater on the lake floor.
encounters.quote: these phenomena are obviously the result of a high technical skill which cannot be credited to any presently known culture on earth
